# Indentation

6 options in this group.

| Key | Default | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [csharp_indent_case_contents](csharp_indent_case_contents.md) | `true` | Indent statements inside a case label. |
| [csharp_indent_switch_labels](csharp_indent_switch_labels.md) | `true` | Indent case labels inside their switch. |
| [csharp_indent_labels](csharp_indent_labels.md) | `one_less_than_current` | How goto labels are indented. |
| [csharp_indent_block_contents](csharp_indent_block_contents.md) | `true` | Indent statements inside a block. |
| [csharp_indent_braces](csharp_indent_braces.md) | `false` | Indent the brace tokens themselves an extra level. |
| [csharp_indent_case_contents_when_block](csharp_indent_case_contents_when_block.md) | `true` | Indent a braced case body. csharp_indent_case_contents governs other statements. |
